subject.title: [Feature]: Channel Broker Phase 2A - broker conformance harness

question: Should OpenClaw create a new Channel Broker SDK/bundled plugin boundary for shared channel conformance, or keep the existing `channel-outbound` and channel plugin contracts as the canonical path?
rationale: The requested harness depends on a public broker seam that is absent from current main and was only proposed in closed unmerged branches that maintainers said need prior approved design boundaries.

options.title: Require a smaller broker design first
options.body: Keep this issue as the narrow tracker until maintainers approve a minimal broker SDK/plugin boundary and its security/config scope.

options.title: Use existing channel contracts
options.body: Treat `channel-outbound` and channel plugin message adapters as the conformance target and avoid adding a separate broker layer.

options.title: Reject broker direction for now
options.body: Close the broker phase work and ask future channel reliability work to stay within the current SDK surfaces unless a concrete gap is proven.

recommendation.title: Require a smaller broker design first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the narrow tracker until maintainers approve a minimal broker SDK/plugin boundary and its security/config scope.

likelyOwner.reason: He provided the explicit boundary feedback on the closed implementation candidate and has recent adjacent plugin SDK history.
